a: Prompt engineering crafts inputs to get better model outputs.
Few-shot prompting includes examples in the prompt.
Chain-of-thought asks the model to reason step by step.
Tool-using models call functions like search or code execution.
Embedding search finds similar text by vector distance.
Chunking splits long documents for retrieval and context limits.
Evaluate with held-out tasks, human review, and automated checks.
Safety layers reduce harmful or disallowed outputs.
Latency is time to first token or full response.
API cost often scales with input and output tokens.
